rowText: All four About links were unreachable by D-pad. Hand-rolled Focusable + onMoveUp/onMoveDown wrappers returned true, so Steam skipped default navigation, while focus was moved with a plain DOM .focus() -- which does not transfer gamepad focus across nav containers... Now plain ButtonItem rows, matching DeveloperTab. On-Deck steps: open the About tab, press Down from the language dropdown through all four links in turn, then Up back to the top. Press A on one link and confirm it opens Steam's own browser (not a dead press). Also settles the last piece of SHELL-PAYLOAD-01 (the About tab's own detailed D-pad walk down its four links).

verdictSentence: All four About links can now be reached with the D-pad going down and coming back up, fixing the old dead-end bug; pressing the button on the GitHub link correctly opened Steam's own web browser to the project's GitHub page. One thing to flag even though the row passed: pressing B to leave the browser closed the whole bonsAI panel instead of just going back to the About screen, so a person would need one extra press to reopen bonsAI -- the panel's own place (still on About) was remembered correctly once reopened.
